summary: Fresh priority frontend tests passed 18/18 and the latest independent Redis execution passed 12/12. Java source preflight confirms only 12 main and 4 test files in the new root, including four package-info.java files. Full frontend verification exited 1 before any of its six checks started: the verifier-created temporary TypeScript runner outside the ESM frontend package was transformed as CommonJS and rejected top-level await. This is a verifier infrastructure failure, not a demonstrated product regression. Execution stopped; backend full verify and fresh JAR inspection were not run. Empty-output launch retries also caused repeated Redis executions with same-name evidence replacement; this limitation is disclosed and no full-suite pass or reusable acceptance is claimed.

findings.title: Empty-output retries caused repeat execution and same-name Redis receipt replacement
findings.observed: Terminal calls sometimes returned no output without a background ID. A Redis receipt read initially showed 07:21:34.905Z-07:23:02.250Z exit 0. Later the same path contained 07:23:17.992Z-07:23:54.373Z exit 0, with matching latest helper/log and launcher. The collector uses fixed phase filenames, so earlier intermediate Redis evidence is not immutable. Exact invocation count and scheduling overlap cannot be established from retained receipts.
findings.disposition: Report the latest consistent retained execution, disclose earlier observations without inventing independent copies, do not aggregate counts across repeats, and do not claim a unique immutable attempt chain or future reuse. This does not establish a product failure. Parent should require unique immutable invocation output names and a fresh complete independent run.
